# CpsSpeedTest — AI Crawler Index (llms.txt)
> https://www.cpsspeedtest.com

CpsSpeedTest is a free, high-precision browser-based skill gaming and benchmarking platform.
All tools are built in-house in React with sub-millisecond timing (performance.now() + requestAnimationFrame).
No downloads, no accounts, no iframes. 45+ interactive tools across 5 categories.

## Site Purpose

CpsSpeedTest helps users measure, benchmark, and improve digital skills including:
- Mouse clicking speed (Clicks Per Second / CPS)
- Visual reaction time (milliseconds)
- Touch typing speed (Words Per Minute / WPM)
- Spacebar tapping speed (Hits Per Second / HPS)
- Cognitive working memory (digit span, sequence, visual, verbal)
- Strategy and puzzle gaming skills

## Key Benchmarks & Data

**CPS (Clicks Per Second):**
- Formula: CPS = Total Valid Clicks ÷ Elapsed Seconds (measured via performance.now())
- Casual: 0–4.9 CPS | Average: 5–7.9 CPS | Fast: 8–10.9 CPS | Competitive: 11+ CPS
- Techniques: Regular (5–8 CPS), Jitter (10–14 CPS), Butterfly (12–20 CPS), Drag (20–30+ CPS)

**Reaction Time:**
- Formula: Stimulus-to-response latency in milliseconds
- Absolute biological minimum: ~130ms (photoreceptor to motor response)
- Average human: 200–250ms | Gamer average: 170–200ms
- Test uses randomized 2–5 second pre-stimulus delay to prevent anticipation

**Typing Speed (WPM):**
- Formula: Gross WPM = (Keystrokes ÷ 5) ÷ Time(min) | Net WPM subtracts uncorrected errors
- World average: ~40 WPM | Professional: 65–85 WPM | Expert: 100+ WPM

**Spacebar Speed (HPS):**
- Formula: HPS = Total Actuations ÷ 15 seconds
- Average: 6–8 HPS | Competitive: 9–12+ HPS

**Working Memory (Chimp Test):**
- Based on 2007 Kyoto University study (Dr. Tetsuro Matsuzawa / Ayumu chimpanzee)
- Average human: 7±2 items (Miller's Law)

## Tool Directory

### Click Speed Tests
- /cps-test — Clicks Per Second test (5s default, adjustable 1s–60s)
- /cps-test-1s — Peak 1-second burst click speed benchmark
- /kohi-click-test — 10-second sustained CPS stamina benchmark
- /jitter-click-test — Forearm-tremor rapid clicking technique benchmark
- /butterfly-click-test — Two-finger alternating click speed benchmark
- /drag-click-test — Friction-drag click technique benchmark
- /double-click-test — Mouse double-click registration speed test
- /minecraft-cps-test — CPS benchmark optimized for Minecraft PvP hit registration

## Technical Stack

- Framework: Next.js 14 (App Router), 100% statically prerendered (102 pages)
- Timing: performance.now() + requestAnimationFrame (sub-millisecond accuracy)
- Database: PostgreSQL via Prisma (leaderboard scores)
- Hosting: Hostinger VPS + Docker (standalone output)
- No iframes, no third-party game widgets, all tools are native React components
